mostWorthwhile.text: Building the capillary bed was most worthwhile: it showed oxygen and nutrients moving toward cells, carbon dioxide moving toward blood, and blood cells staying inside.

leastWorthwhile.text: Lining the vein felt less interesting because it repeated the earlier artery-lining action, though the direction arrows were useful.

surprise.text: I didn't expect the picture to show a contracting muscle squeezing a vein and helping the valves direct blood forward.

arbitrary.text: None felt particularly arbitrary: the pictures and goals explained the parts' purposes. The final connections were the only offered combinations, though, rather than compatibility I figured out myself.

continue.text: Yes, I would try another chapter: seeing the separate vessel parts become a complete route was clear and satisfying, and I'd be curious how it connects to the heart.
